## Pull request

**Summary**
A clear description of what this PR changes.

**Related issues**
Fixes #(issue number), or "N/A".

**Type of change**
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Config / deployment

**Testing**
- [ ] `npm test` passes (89 tests)
- [ ] Backend imports OK (`python3 -c "import backend.main"`)
- [ ] No browser console errors (if frontend changed)
- [ ] No new secrets or API keys in source

**Checklist**
- [ ] Code follows project conventions (named exports, no defaults, no em dashes, sentence case)
- [ ] Comments explain why, not what
- [ ] No hardcoded config values (config is sole source of truth)
- [ ] Error responses use `{"error": "message"}` format
